name: SDF61 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy SDF61 in the Subaru Deep Field, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf61-hubble
story: Hubble looked here for a galaxy from the early universe whose light hinted at very young stars with almost no heavy elements or dust, possibly some of the first generation of stars. Such galaxies would make compelling targets for Webb.

claims.text: SDF61 is a high-redshift galaxy targeted by HST program 15137
The targets are spectroscopically confirmed z > 6 galaxies
Five of the program's galaxies are in the Subaru Deep Field
Their light may indicate very young stellar populations with extremely low metallicity and dust, possibly Pop III dominated
They would make compelling targets for JWST spectroscopy
